title: SoniCraft:Glimmering GIft
description: A rework to the transformations in EnderPreston's SoniCraft, specifically Sonic's Super and Hyper Forms.
body:
I made this addon because I was bored, but I might as well show off...


![SoniCraft Glimmering Gift text logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2b2eb95186e9d0cbd15869a0476b680161126035.png)

(Logo made by Arian 23)

This is another SoniCraft addon I decided to cook up, this time focusing on Sonic's transformations! Super Sonic gains a moveset similar to Sonic Frontiers, and Hyper Sonic is just Super Sonic, but stronger, and his Hyper Flash move can just stop creative players from flying (still deciding if I should keep them). These guys CAN and WILL tear through any single boss (that doesn't have invincibility) and may be genuinely undefeatable, so please be cautious where you decide to deploy them!

Coming soon:
- Darkspine
- Excalibur
- Super Sonic 2/Cyber
- Werehog Rework(?)
- Ultra Sonic (idk about this one)
- Shatter Sonic (?)
- Other forms if I'm REALLY bored.
